what: Terrain ak-portmac-dem, heights in metres as little-endian int16, row-major, north up, regular lon/lat grid (cell centres)
source: AWS Terrain Tiles (Mapzen terrarium encoding, public dataset s3://elevation-tiles-prod), zoom 12, 169 tiles, fetched 2026-11-26, bilinear resample; 55 tile-seam spike cells (|h| > 2,500 m or < -150 m) replaced by the median of their valid 5x5 neighbours
projection: plate carree, cell centres: column i is lon west + (i + 0.5) * dlon, row j is lat north - (j + 0.5) * dlat
